notes: The original was inspected once for layout and both supplied overlapping full-resolution halves once, against the complete C and H witnesses including agreements. Ten contextual crops were created, at the recorded original bounds, enlarged to width 3000 with LANCZOS, autocontrast and unsharp masking. No rotation was applied. Each crop was personally inspected. The existing R3 crop was revisited to place its faint local strokes; no new crop was made. An initially truncated R1 display was not treated as a view; the successful R1 display is recorded.

The sheet is upright, with manuscript page number 112 at bottom-left. No manuscript title or date occurs. All three drawings are reproduced in TikZ. The prose is placed to the right of the twelve-point circle, and the small circle is placed to the left of the three formula lines. No TeX compilation or rendered-layout inspection was performed.

H provides only prose drawing descriptions in this supplied witness. Its underlying project drawing files are not supplied and cannot be assessed. No change row is charged merely for prose versus TikZ or for unspecified arrow directions. Local H family statements do, however, assert an unprimed positive R3 lift and a lower-left negative R3 lift not supported at those locations, and a negative lower-right R2 label where the source has no minus.

The two positive upper R3 lift labels both have omega-prime. This is preserved as a possible source duplication; no unprimed replacement is introduced. At the lower-left R3 endpoint there is no written label. The lower-right R2 endpoint is live positive R2 omega, followed by a small cancelled uncertain omega-like suffix.

The upper Q3 overmark is heavy and overworked; its reading as a tilde is tentative. The lower Q3 decoration is detached to the upper-left of Q, with a separate upright and dense crossed-looking lobes. It is represented locally as unsure{deleted omega|tilde}, including uncertainty over whether it is a cancellation. No pristine tilde is silently attached to the lower Q.

The R1 cylinder has the opposite slant to the C code and carries multiple opposed heads on its rims. The R2 left side also has both directions. These are transcribed as visible directed strokes without deducing them from a covering-space model. The faint short construction bends around R3 and the twelve-point circle are retained as strokes; no cancellation or extra labelled arrow is inferred from retracing alone.

The twelve-point circle has all twelve boundary segments directed around the circumference and six reverse inner arcs. C omitted four intervening outer arrows and exchanged the directions of the two right-hand R3 arcs. All twelve point labels, their signs, primes, indices and clockwise order agree with C and H and were individually checked.

The prose begins with P_i^{omega,zeta} and says prend 12 valeurs distinctes. Its next initial sign remains pq versus P_i; the first choice follows the joined descending pen shape, not a grammatical completion. The word puis lacks the required distinct strokes. The cancelled P_i with doubtful omega before zeta is legible in part. The final live words are et les six; there is no further illegible run. No semicolon is visible after distinctes.

The crossed zeta in the second formula is readable and retained as deleted. The cancelled first-formula superscript remains unsure{zeta}; its high placement is preserved. The second formula has a definite angular 4 over omega in its second R subscript, but a rounded 2 in its final P subscript. The 4 is retained exactly, and the right relation is two-bar equality, not equivalence. Every prime and index in the last line was checked against the crop; no textual change to that line was needed.

No reading was chosen by replacing clear ink with expected mathematics. Mathematical checks below are explicitly conditional: this page and supplied notation packet do not define every index action or relation among the R-values. The source assertion of twelve distinct P-values is not proved by counting twelve distinct formal R-labels.

Changes of uncertainty alone are recorded in mark decisions or these notes, not as independent collation rows. Resolving the R3 prime doubts, Q1 omega-squared, and the first alternative of the R2 tilde doubt does not count as a C content change. H is marked uncertain in D29 because its explicit adjacent note names the competing exponent readings; the H uncertainty there is prose rather than an uncertainty macro.
Main adjudication retains pq as C’s first reading while replacing its unsupported alternative puis by P_i; that narrowing is documented in doubts and M0570, without a C content-change count.

check_events.statement: The twelve circle labels contain exactly one occurrence of each formal signed label (sign, i, omega-or-omega-prime), for two signs and i=1,2,3.
check_events.outcome: An exact Python set comparison of the transcribed twelve tuples with the 2 x 3 x 2 product gave 12 entries, 12 distinct tuples, and equal sets. This checks the formal label inventory only, not numerical distinctness of the prose P-values.

check_events.statement: If zeta-prime=zeta^2, zeta^3=1, and P_i^{omega,zeta}=R_j-zeta R_k, then -zeta-prime P_i^{omega,zeta}=R_k-zeta^2 R_j.
check_events.place: Third formula, last equality together with first formula definition
check_events.outcome: Direct expansion gives -zeta^2 R_j+zeta^3 R_k. Reducing the exponent modulo 3 gives R_k-zeta^2 R_j. Exact coefficient dictionaries were compared successfully. The assumptions are explicit and are not claimed to be proved or defined on this leaf.

check_events.statement: Under a three-cycle action omega on indices and nontrivial zeta^3=1, does the written definition P_i=R_{omega i}-zeta R_{omega^4 i} alone imply P_i=-P_{omega^2 i}?
check_events.outcome: No under these stated test assumptions: choose R_i=0, R_{omega i}=1, R_{omega^2 i}=0. Exact coefficient pairs in 1,zeta give P_i=(1,-1) and -P_{omega^2 i}=(0,0). The written identity is therefore not a general consequence of that hypothetical cyclic definition; further manuscript context could impose additional relations. This does not authorize changing the ink 4 to 2 or declaring the source claim refuted without its full hypotheses.

With a hypothetical three-cycle omega, omega^4=omega, so the two R-indices in the written second formula would coincide. The conditional check exhibits a failure of the far-right identity for independent R-values. The page does not supply enough hypotheses to replace 4 or to refute the intended statement globally.
The conditional final-line identity uses zeta-prime=zeta^2 and zeta^3=1. These are not explicitly established on this page; the equality is consistent under them only.
The prose assertion of twelve distinct P-values is unfinished in its explanation. Twelve distinct formal labels in the circle do not by themselves establish that assertion.
